card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 17 Pro That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 17 Pro That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone 17 Pro / Pro Max Sensor Array 8388608 (0x800000) = wireless charging flex on the back glass.
6291456 (0x600000) = charging port flex (also check the air pressure sensor is connected).

procedure: Test the flagged flex with a known-good OEM part; diode-check FPC.
card.caveats: 0x600000 means a different fault on iPhone 14 / 15 Pro; always decode per model. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
